rollups.text: Vintage and collectible interests/items: the user had a growing collection of vintage postcards and bought more at an antique store in a nearby town on an unspecified month and year, on the 22nd (2023-05-20; 2023-05-20); the user bought a 1960s-era Canon rangefinder at a local thrift store (2023-05-20) and was considering starting a vintage-camera collection (2023-05-24); the user had figurines, Funko Pops, and vintage postcards to organize (2023-05-27..2023-05-28); the user planned a lockable display for approximately 10–15 Attack on Titan figurines and chose the Umbra Trigg Vase Display Case (2023-05-24); the user also asked about storage for trading cards and coins (2023-05-24).

The user’s photography interests and activities developed around a Canon rangefinder: the user bought a 1960s-era Canon rangefinder (2023-05-20), later said they had bought a 1950s-era Canon rangefinder for $80 and were experimenting with black-and-white photography (2023-05-25); the user considered Ilford HP5 Plus 400 for nighttime cityscapes and returned from a nighttime cityscape photo walk with the camera (2023-05-25). The date and era descriptions differ across records.

The user’s Master’s thesis work on AI in medical diagnosis and healthcare outcomes: on 2023-05-25, the user sought research papers, especially on deep learning for medical imaging, and used Mendeley for source tracking and citations while organizing academic work in Trello; on 2023-05-26, the user said they were struggling to find relevant datasets, wanted medical imaging or disease-diagnosis data distinct from the Bike Sharing dataset for a Data Mining course project, and planned to investigate CNNs and U-Net with Keras and TensorFlow; by 2023-05-28, the user was exploring diabetic-retinopathy image classification, VGG16 transfer learning, overfitting prevention, retinal image preprocessing, and open datasets. The records span three days.

The user’s planned Europe trip: the user planned approximately five days in the United Kingdom followed by approximately five days in Ireland during June 2023 (2023-06); on 2023-05-26, the user had not booked a return ticket and was unsure of the return date, and planned to research return options and book a flexible ticket. The user asked about proof of onward travel and whether a one-way ticket could cause entry problems. The trip’s eventual dates and bookings are not recorded.

The user’s proposed Pune-to-Gujarat road trip with the user’s wife was scheduled to start early Thursday, 2023-06-01, and return late Sunday, 2023-06-04; the user preferred to avoid very long driving sessions (planned 2023-05-29). The suggested route included an overnight in Nashik on 2023-06-01, Vadodara on 2023-06-02, Ahmedabad on 2023-06-03, and travel toward Udaipur that day. The recorded itinerary is incomplete and does not include the return-to-Pune plan. Key steps are separated by several days.

The user’s artisanal food business and market activity: the user spent the week before the Spring Fling Market perfecting jam and preparing extra batches; at the market on 2023-05-29, the user sold 25 jars of homemade jam and 12 handmade candles for a total profit of $230, using new display materials including a colorful tablecloth and chalkboard sign. The user was experimenting with garlic-and-rosemary sourdough and considering adding pastries and croissants, testing recipes with customers, and scaling production while maintaining consistency (2023-05-29). The user planned to sell products at Foodie Fest in June 2023 to reach a wider audience. The records cover activity and plans over at least two dates; later outcomes are unknown.

The user’s garden plans: on 2023-05-30, the user planned to harden off seedlings and transplant tomatoes, peppers, cucumbers, and marigolds into a recently built raised bed; marigolds were germinating in small pots. The user also planned to fertilize the garden, especially tomatoes, with homemade compost. The user asked about the reused wood’s possible effect on soil and about plant arrangement; wood type and prior use were not specified. The plans were discussed on the same date, so elapsed time between recorded steps is not established.

The user’s effort to reconcile with their partner after infidelity: on 2023-05-23, the user said trusting their partner again seemed difficult but wanted to try to salvage the relationship; the user planned to look for a couples therapist with their partner and hoped they could make the relationship work, while recognizing it would be a long road. The latest recorded state is a plan to seek therapy; no subsequent outcome is recorded.

The user’s exploration of a reported alien experience and metallic object: during therapy on 2023-05-25, the user discussed beliefs about reptilian aliens and showed the therapist a metallic rod called the Rod; the therapist encouraged attention to feelings, provided resources, and suggested caution about whom to approach. After reviewing the resources, the user chose to contact a ufologist rather than an alien-experience support group. The ufologist offered to examine the Rod at a laboratory and warned that handling it without proper training could be dangerous; the user arranged a meeting for 2023-05-26. On the night of 2023-05-25, the user stayed up researching aliens online and felt overwhelmed. The records do not state what happened at the planned laboratory meeting.
At the Spring Fling Market on 2023-05-29, the user reported selling 25 jars of homemade jam and 12 handmade candles, for a total profit of $230.
